title: Letter 40 — A Resting Place for the Poor
attribution_note: Letter 40 of 46 in the collection Letters Sent — see Letter 1 for provenance.

sections.heading: Build where the poor may rest

pairs.en: *“Dear brother in Christ, Stephen!”*

God will reward you for your diligence. I advise: could one not build now, that there might be a place where the poor may rest, in a seemly place — and there will be money for the building. Be so good as to inquire of Cosmas Ignatyev and of Ignatius Loktev concerning the money. Strive, brother, for Christ's sake. The Lord grant you help.
I live in the forest, that there might be less ringing in my ears, and that my eyes might see less.
Your servant, the unworthy bishop Tikhon.
The 30th day of September, in the year 1771.
